items.titleZh: 圖表：標普500指數一路高歌猛進，創下新紀錄的驚人歷程
items.summaryEn: The S&P 500 returned to an intraday record Tuesday as tech gains, easing oil prices and Treasury yields helped stocks overcome months of market shocks.
items.summaryZh: 週二，標普500指數重回盤中歷史高位，科技股上漲、油價下跌和國債殖利率走低幫助股市克服了數月的市場衝擊。

items.summaryEn: The S&P 500 rose to a fresh all-time intraday high on Tuesday, boosted by gains in key technology names as well as declines in oil prices and Treasury yields.
items.summaryZh: 週二，受主要科技股上漲以及油價和國債殖利率下跌的提振，標普500指數盤中創下歷史新高。

items.title: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.titleEn: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
items.titleZh: 9月勞動市場疲軟，新增就業人數僅2.9萬個，失業率升至4.2%。
items.summaryEn: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.
items.summaryZh: 美國勞工統計局表示，9月非農就業人數僅增加2.9萬人，遠低於先前預測的8.4萬人，失業率升至4.2%。
